title: 有馬記念の後に・終わりではなく！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I won the Arima Kinen! I won the ultimate race of dreams! And that was…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I want to run in an even more heated races! And not just that…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I want to keep showing everyone our dreams! After all, we're the ultimate generation!
